testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reset drawing options when switching selected files ✔ Given writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder ✔ And the user opens and saves each drawing to establish its sheet preview, then closes the drawings ✔ Given the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And two saved drawings are visible in the same folder ✔ And the first drawing is selected in the Options pane ✔ And Load in Defer Mode is unchecked for the first drawing ✔ And `OpenDrawingA.odd` and `OpenDrawingB.odd` are visible in the same folder ✔ When the user selects Load in Defer Mode ✔ And the user selects the second drawing ✔ Then the second drawing is selected and its file name is displayed ✔ And Load in Defer Mode is unchecked for the second drawing ✔ When the user selects the first drawing again ✔ Then Load in Defer Mode is unchecked ✔ And the drawing remains selected without being opened
